messages:
tayla_csm: Heads up 1: MonarchHealth renewal needs a 9mo term and will pay by PO. Procurement requires vendor code + net30 PO. CFO is OOO until Tue so signature may delay. We risk losing our enablement slot if not signed by 5/3.

ron_sales: Can we take a CC temporarily? customer policy says no. I'll ask procurement for a PO ETA.

mei_onboard: Onboarding update: SSO done, data pipeline in QA. We've reserved 5/6 as the GA enablement slot. If contract slips past 5/3 we lose that slot.

ana_revops: I can create vendor code once PO number + billing entity provided. Please have customer send PO draft to billing@redwood.com. Also need latest W-9.

procurement-bot: PO draft opened by procurement@monarchhealth.com (docsend.com/s/monarch-po-v1)

sam_legal: 9mo is fine as an addendum. If CFO can't sign we can accept delegated signer with authority letter. No legal blocker on routing.

tayla_csm: Action items: 1) Ron to get PO draft today; 2) Ana to pre-create vendor code when PO arrives; 3) Sam to draft 9mo addendum; 4) Mei hold enablement tentatively. If we need to bridge seats, RevOps can approve up to 10% one-time credit.

ron_sales: PO draft incoming EOD, they asked for our W-9 and vendor tax info.

ana_revops: W-9 path: /billing/vendor_forms/Redwood_W9_2025.pdf. I'll attach once Ron confirms. I'll approve bridge credit (<=10%) with a short CSM justification.

tayla_csm: I'll prepare the justification and update when PO lands.

(END)
